description: This file defines the SavingsAccountRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor for managing SavingsAccount entities. It includes various query methods for retrieving savings account data based on different criteria, such as client ID, account status, account number, and more. It also contains a complex query for fetching accrual data related to savings accounts.

classes.name: SavingsAccountRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for SavingsAccount entity, providing data access methods with custom queries.

methods.name: findSavingAccountByClientId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of savings accounts associated with a specific client ID.

methods.name: findOneLocked
methods.description: Retrieves a savings account by ID with a pessimistic write lock.

methods.name: findSavingAccountByGsimId
methods.description: Finds savings accounts linked to a specific Gsim ID.

methods.name: findSavingAccountByStatus
methods.description: Finds savings accounts with a specific status.

methods.name: findByClientIdAndGroupId
methods.description: Finds savings accounts matching both client ID and group ID.

methods.name: doNonClosedSavingAccountsExistForClient
methods.description: Checks if non-closed savings accounts exist for a client.

methods.name: findByGroupId
methods.description: Finds savings accounts associated with a specific group ID where client is null.

methods.name: findByIdAndDepositAccountType
methods.description: Finds a savings account by ID and deposit account type.

methods.name: findNonClosedAccountByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds a non-closed savings account by account number.

methods.name: findSavingsAccountByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds a savings account by account number.

methods.name: findByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of savings accounts by status.

methods.name: findByExternalId
methods.description: Finds a savings account by external ID.

methods.name: findIdByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a savings account given its external ID.

methods.name: findAccrualData
methods.description: Fetches accrual data for savings accounts based on date, status, and accounting rule.

methods.name: findSavingsAccountIdsByStatusId
methods.description: Retrieves list of savings account IDs with a specific status.
